question: How is the divine lord characterized as a five-limbed bird in this mantra salutation?
premises: The deity is addressed as a five-limbed bird.
The deity is addressed as the divine lord.
Repeated obeisance is offered to that deity.
inference: The mantra offers repeated obeisance to the divine lord in the form of a five-limbed bird.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of pañca+aṅgīya+vihaṅgāya is uncertain
plain_english: Obeisance, obeisance to the five-limbed bird, the divine lord.
